newsitem.title: KENYA: 13 killed in attack in southwest Burundi - radio.
newsitem.headline: 13 killed in attack in southwest Burundi - radio.

text.p: Thirteen people -- most of them women and children -- were killed when gunmen attacked a town in southwestern Burundi on Monday night, state Burundi radio said late on Tuesday.
It quoted a defence ministry spokesman as saying the 13 were killed by about 50 gunmen who entered Mugara town late on Monday when most of the male residents were out on a security patrol.

The radio, monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation, said the attackers destroyed a health centre run by Swedish nuns. Mugara is six km (four miles) east of Lake Tanganyika bordering on Zaire.

More than 150,000 people have been killed in massacres and a civil war between the Tutsi-dominated army and Hutu rebels since the killing of Burundis first freely elected Hutu president in October 1993.
